newsitem.title: INDIA: India HDFC shr falls on buying curbs.
newsitem.headline: India HDFC shr falls on buying curbs.

text.p: Shares of India's Housing Development Finance Corp Ltd (HDFC) fell sharply in early trade on Tuesday after the central bank imposed curbs on fresh foreign portfolio buying, traders said.
The share dropped 268 rupees, or 5.9 pct, to 4,264 by 0600 GMT at the Bombay Stock Exchange.
The Reserve Bank of India on Monday said that fresh purchases by foreign portfolio funds in the stock would need its prior approval because such holdings had reached a watch-list limit of 26 percent.
The ceiling on foreign fund holdings in the firm is 30 percent.
The share was down 236.25 rupees at 4,303.65 at the National exchange.
